title: Rollback Procedure
content: Step-by-step procedure to rollback to a previous version when deployment fails.

items.title: Identify problem version
items.why: Know which version needs to be rolled back
items.what: Determine current broken version and target rollback version
items.how: git describe --tags — Shows current version; decide to rollback to vX.Y.(Z-1)

items.title: Stop application (if needed)
items.what: Stop server or disable access temporarily
items.how: On hosting: make stop OR set maintenance mode

items.title: Checkout previous version
items.what: Use git to revert to previous tagged version
items.how: git checkout vX.Y.(Z-1) — Reverts code to previous release

items.title: Locate database backup
items.why: Find backup file for rollback version
items.what: Check backups directory for version-specific backup

items.title: Backup current database
items.why: Safety net in case rollback fails
items.how: make backup-database version=vX.Y.Z-broken paths='database/local data/' — Preserve current state

items.title: Restore database from backup
items.why: Revert database to previous working state
items.how: tar -xzf backups/vX.Y.(Z-1)-backup.tar.gz -C ./ — Extracts database files to original locations

items.title: Verify file permissions
items.how: chmod -R 755 database/local data/ — Set appropriate permissions

items.title: Test functionality
items.how: make test — All tests should pass; manually test critical features

items.title: Verify data integrity
items.why: Ensure database is consistent and not corrupted
items.what: Check key data points and relationships
items.how: Query important tables, verify record counts, check foreign keys

items.title: Restart application
items.what: Start server with rolled back version
items.how: make serve OR restart web server (nginx, apache, etc.)

items.title: Monitor for errors
items.what: Watch logs for errors or warnings

items.title: Document rollback
items.why: Track history and learn from issue
items.how: make history-add action='rollback' msg='Rolled back from vX.Y.Z to vX.Y.(Z-1) due to <reason>' — Record in history

items.title: Investigate root cause
items.what: Analyze what went wrong in failed version
items.how: Review git diff, check logs from broken version, document findings

items.title: Plan fix and re-release
items.how: Fix code → Test → Build vX.Y.(Z+1) → Deploy with fix
